content: Before I print anything, take another look at your design. Send me the design again with submit_design, changed or unchanged. I'll print the final part from what you send.

I re-checked the design before resending it. The main problem is that it can't be printed as I wrote it. The cavity is closed on all sides, so the support under the front wall would be trapped. I've added a window through the back plate, sized to stay clear of the corner posts and the keyholes, so supports can be pulled out. The rest of the geometry is unchanged. I still haven't confirmed the disc thickness, perfboard thickness, or the direction of the USB port offset, so those are listed as questions.

def build(p):
    W, H, D = p.box_w, p.box_h, p.box_d
    t, bp, ft = p.wall_t, p.back_t, p.front_t
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').box(W, H, D, centered=(True, True, False))
    cav = cq.Workplane('XY').box(W - 2*t, H - 2*t, D - bp - ft, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((0, 0, bp))
    body = body.cut(cav)
    cx = p.perf_w/2 - p.perf_hole_inset
    cy = p.perf_l/2 - p.perf_hole_inset
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        for sy in (-1, 1):
            x, y = sx*cx, sy*cy
            post = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.standoff_d/2).extrude(p.standoff_h).translate((x, y, bp))
            body = body.union(post)
            pilot = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.m2_pilot_d/2).extrude(p.standoff_h + 1).translate((x, y, bp))
            body = body.cut(pilot)
    win = cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.win_w, p.win_y1 - p.win_y0, bp + 2, centered=(True, False, False)).translate((-p.win_w/2, p.win_y0, -1))
    body = body.cut(win)
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        x = sx*p.hang_spacing/2
        y = p.hang_y
        big = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.keyhole_d/2).extrude(bp + 2).translate((x, y, -1))
        slot = cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.slot_w, p.slot_len, bp + 2, centered=(True, False, False)).translate((x, y - p.slot_len, -1))
        rnd = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.slot_w/2).extrude(bp + 2).translate((x, y - p.slot_len, -1))
        body = body.cut(big).cut(slot).cut(rnd)
    for sx in (-1, 1):
        h = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.insert_hole_d/2).extrude(ft + 2).translate((sx*p.disc_hole_pitch/2, 0, D - ft - 1))
        body = body.cut(h)
    ws = cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.wire_slot_w, 6, 10).translate((0, p.wire_slot_y, D - 2))
    body = body.cut(ws)
    port_z = bp + p.standoff_h + p.perf_t + p.esp_port_bottom + p.esp_port_h/2
    usb = cq.Workplane('XY').box(p.usb_cut_w, 8, p.usb_cut_h).translate((p.esp_port_x_off, -H/2 + 2, port_z))
    body = body.cut(usb)
    return body
